verdict.rationale: Ramp Treasury lets operating cash earn yield inside Ramp. The Checking Account used for instant bill payments pays 2% APY, and reserve cash can earn up to 4.46% in a Ramp Investment Account, all within the same platform. The Banking API exposes these as checking (WALLET), brokerage (money-market) and managed-portfolio account types, and the yield sources and $5,000 investment minimum are documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the yield product (all evidence is vendor-claimed)
